youtube.title: The animal with the biggest eyes? Bigger than a football 👁️
youtube.description:
The biggest animal, the biggest bird, or the third one? The largest eyes on Earth are as wide as a football, and they belong to a creature that has only been seen alive a handful of times — because it lives a kilometre down in the coldest sea on the planet, hiding from one very large hunter.
Which did you pick?
